title: Classic Deviled Eggs
description: Hard-cooked egg whites filled with a smooth, tangy yolk mixture and finished with paprika and chives.
equipment: Piping bag or zip-top bag, optional

image.alt: Deviled eggs dusted with paprika and chives on a plate

steps.text: Lower the eggs into a pan of boiling water, reduce to a simmer and cook for {time 12 min}. Move them straight into the ice water for {time 10 min}.
Peel the eggs, halve them lengthwise and pop the yolks into a bowl. Set the whites on a plate.
Mash the yolks until fine, then stir in the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, salt and pepper until smooth.
Spoon or pipe the filling into the whites. Dust with paprika and scatter with chives.

notes: Older eggs peel more easily than very fresh ones.
Make the filling and whites up to a day ahead and keep them separately covered; fill just before serving.
